name: fzf
description: Command-line fuzzy finder with UNIX pipe integration and preview

fzf.description: Command-line fuzzy finder with UNIX pipe integration and preview
fzf.usage:
ls | fzf # Fuzzy select from list
fzf --preview 'cat {}' # Preview files
history | fzf # Search command history
git log --oneline | fzf --preview 'git show {1}' # Interactive git log
